text:
rebecca (Design): quick copy review for the Delete Model Version confirmation. current modal: `Are you sure you want to delete this version?` buttons: Cancel / Delete. problem: vague and doesn't state impact (rollbacks, traffic, artifacts). want clearer microcopy and accessible button labels.
tara (Eng): agree. Deleting a version impacts routes pinned to it and is irreversible. need language that helps users understand consequences without legalese. also avoid long lines in modal.
mike (PM): goals: 1) safety-first tone, 2) explicit mention of irreversible + traffic rollback, 3) action button label should include the word "delete" and the entity type for clarity in SR reads. keep it short.
sam (A11y): suggestions: avoid ambiguous single-word buttons like "Delete" alone. screen readers benefit from more descriptive labels like "Delete version v2.1" or include aria-label on the button. also ensure the modal has role="dialog" and focus trap.
lex (Docs): docs recommend pattern: one-line summary + one short consequence line. examples: 
"Delete version v2.1? This will permanently remove the model artifacts and unpin any routes using it." or 
"Permanently delete version v2.1. Routes pinned to this version will fall back to the default model."
i18n-bot: note: keep the version token separate for translation. avoid contractions for some locales.
rebecca (Design): proposing tight copy pairings: 
1) Title: "Delete version v2.1?" Body: "This permanently deletes model artifacts and unpins routes using this version." Action: "Delete version v2.1" Secondary: "Cancel"
2) Title: "Permanently delete version v2.1" Body: "Routes pinned to this version will be routed to the default model. This action cannot be undone." Action: "Permanently delete v2.1" Secondary: "Keep version"
3) Title: "Remove version v2.1" Body: "Removing this version is irreversible and will remove associated artifacts." Action: "Remove version v2.1" Secondary: "Cancel"
tara (Eng): option 1 is concise and hits the points. prefer using "Delete version v2.1" as action text so SRs announce full context. also add data-confirm attribute for the api call.
sam (A11y): prefer option 2's explicit "cannot be undone" phrase but shorter. maybe combine: Title: "Delete version v2.1?" Body: "This permanently deletes model artifacts and unpins any routes using this version. This cannot be undone." Action: "Delete version v2.1" Secondary: "Cancel"
lex (Docs): that's good. docs will mirror the modal copy and document the fallback behavior. lex: add a note that examples should use the token {version} not literal v2.1.
i18n-bot: flagged: translators may need context about "unpin" and "default model". add translator note: "unpin: remove model binding from routes so they fall back to organization's default model".
rebecca (Design): finalizing on combined copy. i'll update the component token: 
Title: "Delete version {version}?" 
Body: "This permanently deletes model artifacts and unpins any routes using this version. This cannot be undone." 
Primary button: "Delete version {version}" 
Secondary button: "Cancel"
tara (Eng): i'll add aria-labels and ensure the primary button also has an aria-describedby referencing the body. will implement confirm dialog test.
sam (A11y): i'll run a quick SR test on the branch. suggest adding visually-hidden text for users to confirm the version id when actioning.
rebecca (Design): thanks all. I'll drop the token into the design system and ping i18n for translation notes. mike (PM): adding to release notes: clearer delete confirmation for model versions.
